title: Run through literal evaluation
statement: Let $x$ be a bit string, $B\in\mathbb{N}$, $b\in\{0,1\}$, and let $st=(K,S,P,T,Z,C,V)$ be a seven-register state. If every register is at most $B$ and $T=Z=C=0$, the machine has a guarded run from label $lv(0,b)$ with state $st$ to label $cl(\mathrm{asg}(K,S,V)=b)$ with state $(K,S,P,T,Z,C,0)$.
hypotheses_covered: all seven registers are at most $B$
replaced:
Let $x$ be a bit string, $B$ a natural number, $b$ a bit, and $st$ a seven-register
state. If every register of $st$ is at most $B$ and the scratch registers $T,Z,C$ are
zero, then the machine has a guarded run from state $\mathrm{lv}(\mathrm{false},b)$ and
register state $st$ to state $\mathrm{cl}(\mathrm{asg}(st.K,st.S,st.V)=b)$, with the
same registers except that $V$ is set to zero.
